page0.text: It'd be dangerous for me to leave this spot without first figuring out what's going on.

page1.text:
"I'm staying. Are you set on going...?"
"Yeah. But you're making the right choice. I have Archer, but you're alone.
It isn't wrong to be cautious."

page2.text:
"...All right. Don't get careless just because Archer's here."
"Of course not. I'll be right back if it looks dangerous."

page3.text:
Tohsaka runs into the woods without looking back.
...The air continues rumbling.
Tohsaka said that Berserker is fighting.
He must be up against Zouken and Assassin.
Berserker won't lose in pure fighting strength.
There's no tactic that Assassin or Zouken could use to overcome him.
But...wasn't that true for Saber, too?

page4.text:
...
...I have an ominous hunch that I might be making the same mistake as before...

page5.text:
"...!?"
Darkness falls.
It isn't the darkness that comes from an absence of light.
Instead, a dark light is seared into my retinas, like I've just looked directly into the sun.

page6.text:
"Eh?"
My worsening sense of dread is accompanied by a new worry.
I'm in complete darkness. I can't tell up from down or left from right.
It's like an awful, sudden hallucination that I've been swallowed into a world of nothingness.

page7.text:
"No...it can't be...!"
Without my vision, I feel my way through the lightless forest.
Thud. Thump.
I bump into tree trunks.

page8.text:
"Hah... hah, hah, hah, ah...!"
I push my way forward clumsily.
Blood trickles from my shoulders.
My forehead slams into a hard tree trunk. The pain is intense.
Still, I want the feedback.
Getting injured from bumping into things is more comforting than nothing at all.

page9.text:
"Hah... hah, hah, hah."
It'll be okay.
I'll be all right. It's just temporary blindness from seeing a sudden bright light.
The forest is still there, and I can feel the ground beneath my feet.
Everything's just gone dark in my eyes.
I'll recover with time.

page10.text:
...It should take just a little longer before my eyes work again.
I don't know what that light was, and I'm worried about Tohsaka, but I'd just be a burden to her if I rushed in.
I need to concentrate on recovering my eyesight and escaping this darkness.

page11.text:
...
......
.........
............
...............Just a little more.
I'm sure my eyesight will return soon.
There's nothing to worry about.
My eyesight will return. I can say that for sure.

page12.text:
...
But I am worried about the noises around me.
The gusts of wind stopped at some point.
The thumping noises are gone, too.
I wonder what it means that I've stopped bumping into all those trees.

page13.text:
"Almost there. Just a little more."
Just a little longer until my eyesight is back.
I need to wait in this dark void until then.
I'll focus on that for now.
I can ponder later why I'm not touching the forest anymore.
I can wonder later why it's dark even though my eyes are working again and my vision is back to normal.

page14.text:
"...Right. Just gotta get out of this darkness as soon as I can."
Still feeling nothing, I walk through the darkness.
...I know I'm in the middle of a forest, but it's so dark that my imagination goes to bad places.

page15.text:
For example...
Maybe I got trapped in a world of shadows with no exit.
A bad joke like that, maybe.

page17.text:
I chuckle bitterly at how lame it sounds, and keep going.
I can't feel anything.
But it's just a little longer.
A little longer.
A little longer.
A little longer.
Just a little longer until my eyesight returns,
and I see the place I was just in earlier...
